answer.rationale: The 18% cost mandate and 14-day renewal deadline create urgency. Memory_c2 documents that switching to the low-cost vendor delivered sharp unit cost reduction with quick onboarding and reliable invoicing—precisely what we need now. The incumbent's leverage (memory_c4, memory_c6) came from renegotiation and multi-year terms, but we lack time to pursue that path. Memory_c3 shows second-sourcing removes supply risk, but we have capacity for only one decision this cycle and assembly line buffer is already thin at 94% volume. The low-cost vendor's quote meets the 18% mandate directly. Primary risk: switching at 94% utilization leaves no recovery margin if onboarding hits friction or quality issues. Mitigation: treat as standard_experiment (not broad_rollout) to catch problems early; defer second-source decision to next cycle once volume stabilizes.
